papers.title: When Agents Slow Down: Understanding LLM Agents' Test-Time Strategies via Elo-per-token Analysis
papers.authors: Liu, Mang, Peng, Chai, Li, Pimpalgaonkar, Zettlemoyer, Dimakis, Cheung
papers.what: Tracks the best solution found at each token budget and aggregates within-task orderings into Elo with a Bradley-Terry model, showing that agents beat independent sampling early then fall below it, and that splitting 100M tokens into parallel sessions sized at the scaling inflection point gains 264 Elo over one long session and 355 over ten short ones.
papers.builds_on: LATS (Zhou 2024, 77ERE7HA); DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); TTT for Abstract Reasoning (Akyurek 2024, W7RPRTCH)

papers.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
papers.authors: Zheng, Wu, Zhang, He et al. (Google)
papers.what: Reuses accumulated discovery trees as a replay simulator so that exploration policies can be improved off-policy for free, then redeploys the improved policy online to expand the simulator, matching or improving discovery quality at lower online evaluation cost on algorithm engineering, mathematical optimization, and GPU kernel engineering.
papers.builds_on: Offline RL (Levine 2020, ZULLM3UF); OPE Study (Voloshin 2021, Y2MKM9Y3); LATS (Zhou 2024, 77ERE7HA)

papers.title: Omni-Streaming Thinking
papers.authors: Du, Liu, Zheng, Li, Guo, Zhang, Zou
papers.what: Keeps audio and visual evidence in separate stores and marks every claim pending until the verification interval that would settle it has elapsed, so a visually motivated interpretation can be refuted by later audio, beating open baselines by over 10 percent relative on five streaming benchmarks and reaching d-prime 2.95 against at most 1.38.
papers.builds_on: Where Does the Sound Go? (Jo 2026, 2609.05871); LTU (Gong 2023, ESEEEH85); Flamingo (Alayrac 2022, SC8KWYVK)

papers.title: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
papers.what: Encodes language responses, end-effector motion, and dense visual targets as discrete tokens under one autoregressive objective, taking all embodied pre-training supervision from human interaction video rather than robot hardware, and averages 72.5 across 28 embodied understanding benchmarks with open 8B and 2B weights released the same day.
papers.builds_on: World Models (Ha 2018, 938DAXZT); DINO-WM (Zhou 2025, W44RSJJI); Flamingo (Alayrac 2022, SC8KWYVK)
